python3 - <<'PY'
import json,random
random.seed(3)
Q=16;L=8;U=2147483648;R=32
b=[0]+sorted(random.sample(range(1,U),R-1))+[U]
steps=[];t=0;ids=0
for k in range(40000):
    t+=1
    lanes=random.sample(range(L),3)
    arr=[{'id':f'i{ids+j}','lane':lanes[j],'rank':random.randrange(U)} for j in range(3)]
    ids+=3
    steps.append({'t':t,'serve':True,'arrivals':arr})
req={'mode':'stream','banks':Q,'lanes':L,'limit':U,'borders':b,'capacity':20000,'epoch':1,'steps':steps}
open('/workspace/tmp/perf3.json','w').write(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')))
PY
TIMEFORMAT='time=%3R'; time python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < /workspace/tmp/perf3.json > /workspace/tmp/perf3.out
echo rc=$?; ls -lh /workspace/tmp/perf3.out
